infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
The Rhodes Island Recon, composed of the Felyne Masamune and the Canyne Yoshitsune, takes its name from the unit they belonged to back home in Kamura Village—the 'Buddy Recon.' Masamune and Yoshitsune had already received professional training in intelligence investigation and material gathering, and had spent a long time honing their skills in Houei. As such, they immediately began playing important roles in all manner of missions the moment they joined Rhodes Island. They want to find a way home, but they are also quite enthusiastic about adventuring on Terra, so they have adapted to life here fairly well.
The lively, friendly Masamune quickly became a star among the Operators—many Operators applied to go on missions with Masamune simply to see the adorable talking 'cloudbeast,' while the originally aloof Yoshitsune has also hit it off with many Operators who are passionate about combat.
text.zh:
由艾露猫政宗和牙猎犬义经组成的罗德岛隐秘队，命名来自他们在家乡炎火村隶属的编制——“随从隐秘队”。政宗和义经在情报调查和素材收集方面本就接受过专业训练，且在泡影国磨练了很长时间，因此，刚加入罗德岛就立刻在各项任务中发挥了重要作用。他们想要找到回家的道路，但本身也相当热衷于在泰拉大陆上进行冒险，因而，在这里的生活，他们适应得还算不错。
活泼友善的政宗迅速成为干员中的明星——许多干员都申请和政宗一起出任务，为的就是看一看会说话的可爱“云兽”，而原本孤高的义经也和许多热衷于战斗的干员打成一片。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory systems and there is no sign of infection. At this time, the two operators are believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Masamune and Yoshitsune show no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，两位干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
政宗和义经均没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】未公开
根据医疗部决议，不公开相关数据。

text.en:
When the concept of a 'hunter' came up in conversation with the members of Team A6, Masamune's usual liveliness faded, replaced by a certain seriousness, and Yoshitsune, who had been dozing off to the side, pricked up his ears.
In their homeland, Hunters are charged with protecting the ecosystem as they hunt monsters. Thus, every hunter is a forerunner who explores the unknown. 'The Fierce,' for example, was the great hero who resolved Kamura Village's crisis—the 'Rampage.'
'All great hunters share one trait: a never-give-up spirit!'
No matter how troublesome the enemy, and no matter how many times they fail, true hunters will keep challenging their quarry until they win, or until they fall. As Masamune describes it, a 'hunter' is not only a profession, but also a symbol of a certain spirit.
'That sounds like the furthest thing from our squad,' Spot could not help but say.
'Yeah, I think so too. I'm not anything that impressive. I just think it's fun,' Catapult chimed in. A never-give-up spirit? She certainly did not think her reason for picking up the charge blade was that noble.
But Masamune shook his head.
'If this were before, I might have thought the same. But things are different now. Whether it's the people of Houei or the people of Rhodes Island, only the opponents they fight and their reasons for fighting are different from hunters! Everyone has that never-give-up spirit!'
text.zh:
在和A6小队的成员们聊到“猎人”这个概念时，政宗一改往常的活泼，变得有些严肃，在一旁假寐的义经也竖起了耳朵。
在他们的故乡，猎人要做的事情，是在狩猎怪物的同时保护生态，因此，每一位猎人，都是探索未知的先驱者，比如“炎火村的烈焰”，正是解决炎火村危机——“百龙夜行”的大英雄。
“优秀的猎人都有一项特质，那就是——永不言弃的挑战精神喵！”
无论面对怎样棘手的敌人，无论失败多少次，真正的猎人总是会不断地发起挑战，直到胜利，或者倒下。在政宗的口中，“猎人”不仅是一种职业，更是一种精神的象征。
“看起来是离我们这支小队最远的东西。”斑点忍不住说道。
“我也觉得欸，我没那么了不起的，我只是觉得好玩而已。”空爆也附和道。挑战精神？她可不觉得自己拿起盾斧的理由有那么高尚。
但政宗却摇了摇头。
“如果是以前的话，我可能也会这么想喵。但是现在不一样了，泡影国的人也好，罗德岛的人也好，只是战斗的对象和理由跟猎人不一样喵！大家都是富有挑战精神的人喵！”
